capabilities: Show backlinks as cards with the whole block around each link
Find title matches and unlinked mentions and link them in one click
List notes created on a daily or weekly note's day or week
Collect tasks from linking notes that belong to the current note
Display the same cards in a draggable sidebar pane
extras: The listing notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; it needs Obsidian 1.7.2 or later, works on desktop and mobile, and makes no network requests.
intentEvidence: Obsidian's core Backlinks plugin can also list backlinks at the bottom of notes, which would give you two lists.
problem: Obsidian's built-in backlinks show one-line search hits without block context, and turning unlinked mentions into links takes manual editing.

relations.evidence: If the Periodic Notes plugin is on with weekly notes turned on, its format and folder are used.

summary: Backlinks viewer that shows each linking note as a card with its whole surrounding block, plus title matches, unlinked mentions, and related tasks.
